g.text: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 · 6 tasks · 2 operators · 3 seeds per method · 90-second episode ceiling
Circles: seed observations; crosses: failed or unconfirmed episodes; diamonds: arithmetic means.
Failed episodes retain score −1. Score = clipped (1 − selected latency / paired reference latency).
